unlock.title: Unlock the installer
unlock.description: Enter the setup password configured on the server to continue.
unlock.error.wrong: That setup password is not correct.
unlock.installer.title: Setup is not configured
unlock.installer.description: The server has no valid setup password, so the installer cannot start.
unlock.installer.step1: Set the SETUP_PASSWORD environment variable to a value of at least 12 characters.
unlock.installer.hint: The password is never shown here. You can remove it after the installation is complete.
